glosses: A slope; an incline, inclination.

glosses: An oblique movement or course.

glosses: An area of ground that tends evenly upward or downward.

examples.text: I had to climb a small slope to get to the site.

glosses: The degree to which a surface tends upward or downward.

examples.text: The road has a very sharp downward slope at that point.

glosses: The ratio of the vertical and horizontal distances between two points lying on the line.

examples.text: The slope of this line is 0.5

glosses: The slope of the line tangent to the curve at the given point.

examples.text: The slope of a parabola increases linearly with x.

glosses: The angle a roof surface makes with the horizontal, expressed as a ratio of the units of vertical rise to the units of horizontal length (sometimes referred to as run).

examples.text: The slope of an asphalt shingle roof system should be 4:12 or greater.
